title: Reject invalid persisted Site identity and empty required collections

opportunity.rootCause: SitePersistenceCodec.FromRow accepted malformed Site IDs and empty hostname/path-prefix arrays before later snapshot validation.
opportunity.risk: Malformed database rows could become runtime Site objects with ambiguous identity or incomplete routing data.

implementation.behavior: FromRow validates the shared Site ID grammar, canonicalizes valid IDs, and rejects empty hostname/path-prefix collections before constructing GatewaySite.

red.result: failed 1/1 because invalid identity and empty required collections produced no exception

canonicalizationRed.result: failed 1/1 when persistence returned the uncanonicalized row ID
